resources.string: The keyboard stops suggesting it. You can teach it again whenever you like.
Keyboard languages\n\nAll of them are used at once. To add one, download its file with the browser and pick it with «Add». Tap an imported one to remove it.
There are already %1$d imported languages; remove one before adding another.

Its SHA-256 matches none of those published with Lapacho:

%1$s

It may be a custom dictionary, one published after this version, or a modified one. The worst it can do is suggest words you do not want. Import it only if you know where it came from.
«%1$s» added. The keyboard uses it the next time it opens.
The keyboard stops suggesting its words. You can import it again whenever you like.

Android will not read the file through the «Downloads» shortcut.

Tap Add again and reach the same file through the phone's storage: menu ☰ → the phone's name → Download.
